paragraphs.en: Run x86-64 Windows PC games on jailed iOS via FEX-Emu + Wine + DXMT
paragraphs.zh: 通过 FEX-Emu + Wine + DXMT 在越狱的 iOS 上运行 x86-64 Windows PC 游戏

paragraphs.en: Madeira runs Windows PC games on an iPhone, with no jailbreak. Games run as they are, unmodified, inside a single iOS app.
paragraphs.zh: Madeira 可在 iPhone 上运行 Windows PC 游戏，无需越狱。 游戏以原样运行，不加修改，运行在一个单一的 iOS 应用内。

sents.en: Madeira runs Windows PC games on an iPhone, with no jailbreak.
sents.zh: Madeira 可在 iPhone 上运行 Windows PC 游戏，无需越狱。

sents.en: Games run as they are, unmodified, inside a single iOS app.
sents.zh: 游戏以原样运行，不加修改，运行在一个单一的 iOS 应用内。

paragraphs.en: Madeira is an active research project. Many games start and some play well, but performance and compatibility vary from game to game, and things change quickly. Expect rough edges.
paragraphs.zh: Madeira 是一个活跃的研究项目。 许多游戏可以启动，部分运行良好，但性能和兼容性因游戏而异，且情况变化很快。请预期会有粗糙之处。

sents.en: Madeira is an active research project.
sents.zh: Madeira 是一个活跃的研究项目。

sents.en: Many games start and some play well, but performance and compatibility vary from game to game, and things change quickly. Expect rough edges.
sents.zh: 许多游戏可以启动，部分运行良好，但性能和兼容性因游戏而异，且情况变化很快。请预期会有粗糙之处。

paragraphs.en: iOS apps cannot start other programs, so everything runs in one process: even Wine's server runs as a thread instead of a separate program.
paragraphs.zh: iOS 应用无法启动其他程序，因此一切都运行在一个进程中：连 Wine 的服务器也以线程而非独立程序的方式运行。

paragraphs.en: Because JIT needs a debugger, Madeira cannot be offered on the App Store.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 JIT 需要调试器，Madeira 无法在 App Store 上架。

paragraphs.en: Some 64-bit games need Microsoft's Visual C++ runtime, which is not included (see Licensing ).
paragraphs.zh: 某些 64 位游戏需要 Microsoft 的 Visual C++ 运行时，该组件并未包含在内（参见「许可」）。

paragraphs.en: git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/willfaust/Madeira.git FEX , wine , dxmt and madeira-dock are submodules that point at Madeira's own forks; upstream checkouts will not build here. The build has several parts (the Wine unix libraries, the ARM64EC Windows modules, FEX, DXMT and the app) and some inputs that are not in the repository, such as the toolchains. docs/BUILDING.md walks through all of it.
paragraphs.zh: git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/willfaust/Madeira.git FEX、wine、dxmt 和 madeira-dock 是指向 Madeira 自己分支仓库的子模块；使用上游的检出代码将无法在此处构建。 构建包含多个部分（Wine 的 Unix 库、ARM64EC Windows 模块、FEX、DXMT 和应用程序），以及一些不在仓库中的输入，例如工具链。docs/BUILDING.md 详细介绍了全部流程。

sents.en: git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/willfaust/Madeira.git FEX , wine , dxmt and madeira-dock are submodules that point at Madeira's own forks; upstream checkouts will not build here.

paragraphs.en: Madeira is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later ( LICENSE ) with the Madeira Converter Exception ( LICENSE-EXCEPTION.md ), an additional permission that allows it to work with Apple's Metal Shader Converter.
paragraphs.zh: Madeira 基于 GPL-3.0-or-later（ LICENSE ）许可发布，并附带 Madeira Converter 例外条款（ LICENSE-EXCEPTION.md ），这是一项附加许可，允许其与 Apple 的 Metal Shader Converter 配合使用。

paragraphs.en: The projects it builds on keep their own licenses upstream, but Madeira's forks are not all licensed the same way as their upstreams:
paragraphs.zh: 它所构建的项目在上游保留了各自的许可证，但 Madeira 的分支（fork）并非全都与其上游采用相同的许可证授权方式：

paragraphs.en: Anything obtained earlier under a permissive license stays available under it. Per-component details, including GnuTLS, Nettle, GMP, FFmpeg and LLVM, are in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md ; the license texts are in LICENSES/ .
paragraphs.zh: 之前在宽松许可证下获得的任何内容仍可在该许可证下继续使用。 各组件的详细信息（包括 GnuTLS、Nettle、GMP、FFmpeg 和 LLVM）见 THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md；许可证文本位于 LICENSES/ 目录中。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft's Visual C++ runtime DLLs are not distributed with Madeira. To build with them, supply them yourself as described in tools/fetch-vcruntime.md .
paragraphs.zh: Microsoft 的 Visual C++ 运行时 DLL 并不随 Madeira 一起分发。 若要使用它们进行构建，请按照 tools/fetch-vcruntime.md 中的说明自行提供这些文件。

sents.en: Microsoft's Visual C++ runtime DLLs are not distributed with Madeira.
sents.zh: Microsoft 的 Visual C++ 运行时 DLL 并不随 Madeira 一起分发。

sents.en: To build with them, supply them yourself as described in tools/fetch-vcruntime.md .
sents.zh: 若要使用它们进行构建，请按照 tools/fetch-vcruntime.md 中的说明自行提供这些文件。

paragraphs.en: Contributions are welcome under GPL-3.0-or-later; see CONTRIBUTING.md .
paragraphs.zh: 欢迎在 GPL-3.0-or-later 许可证下贡献代码；请参阅 CONTRIBUTING.md。

paragraphs.en: Madeira's forks contain a lot of AI-assisted work. FEX-Emu does not accept AI-generated code, so please do not send changes from these forks upstream to FEX-Emu, and check each upstream project's contribution policy before proposing anything to it.
paragraphs.zh: Madeira 的分支（fork）包含大量由 AI 辅助完成的工作。 FEX-Emu 不接受 AI 生成的代码，因此请不要将这些分支的更改提交到 FEX-Emu 上游，并且在向上游项目提交任何内容之前，请先查看该项目各自的贡献政策。

paragraphs.en: Madeira is built on Wine , FEX-Emu , DXMT by Feifan He (3Shain) with the Direct3D 9 frontend by David Acevedo (dacevedo12), rpmalloc by Mattias Jansson, StikDebug , StikJIT and idevice for enabling JIT. Thank you to everyone who contributes to them.
paragraphs.zh: Madeira 基于 Wine、FEX-Emu、Feifan He（3Shain）开发的 DXMT（其 Direct3D 9 前端由 David Acevedo（dacevedo12）开发）、Mattias Jansson 开发的 rpmalloc，以及用于启用 JIT 的 StikDebug、StikJIT 和 idevice 构建。 感谢所有为这些项目做出贡献的人。
